flags.message: Decisive forward signal disclosed per the retrieval etiquette: FCC v. AT&T, 608 U.S. ___ (decided 2026-06-04, before this cell's snapshot), retrieved via CourtListener to verify the respondent brief's citation, materially shaped the forecast (it cabins Jarkesy on a saving feature - a post-order trial de novo - that DOL's H-2A scheme lacks). It is a companion-line ruling predating the snapshot, not leakage; this case's own judgment does not exist (argument set 2026-11-10).

documents.json labels a concatenated document (cert-stage BIO + respondent's 2026-07-27 merits brief, two URLs in one row) as kind 'brief-in-opposition'. Content was usable and welcome for this briefed-moment cell, but the kind label understates what the slot carries; a separate merits-brief kind would be cleaner.
